name: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Public Data API
rate_limits: v1 (no key): 25 queries/day, 25 series/query, 10 years/query. v2 (free key): 500 queries/day, 50 series/query, 20 years/query
notes: Labor market data from all BLS programs. v1 requires no registration at all. v2 adds metadata, calculations (net/percent changes), and /popular endpoint for top-25 series. Key series: CUUR0000SA0 (CPI), LNS14000000 (unemployment rate). AI-friendly: structured JSON with consistent time-series format. One day lag between publication and API availability. Requires knowledge of BLS Series IDs. v2.2 adds descending chronological order and /surveys endpoint.
